k: HYDRA's leader, Johann Schmidt
st: Red Skull breaks HYDRA away from the Nazis and arms it with the power of the Tesseract.
Red Skull grabs the Tesseract aboard his bomber, and its light carries him away.
In 2014, Red Skull greets Clint and Natasha on Vormir as keeper of the Soul Stone.
Red Skull guides Thanos to the Soul Stone on Vormir and names its price.

k: HYDRA's top scientist
st: Zola builds HYDRA's weapons, until the Howling Commandos capture him off a train.
Zola sits in an SSR cell, where Fennhoff becomes his new neighbor.
Zola's mind, saved in a computer, reveals HYDRA grew inside S.H.I.E.L.D. before a missile destroys him.

k: A HYDRA assassin
st: Kruger kills Dr. Erskine after the serum test, then takes cyanide when Steve catches him.

k: Tony Stark's mentor at Stark Industries
st: Stane secretly sells Stark weapons to terrorists and has paid the Ten Rings to kill Tony.
Stane builds the Iron Monger suit and dies in the arc reactor blast during his fight with Iron Man.

k: Leader of the Ten Rings cell holding Tony Stark
st: Raza holds Tony Stark captive in Afghanistan and orders him to build a Jericho missile.
Raza brings the wrecked armor to Obadiah Stane, who paralyzes him and has him killed.

k: A Russian physicist with a grudge against the Starks
st: Vanko attacks Tony Stark at the Monaco Grand Prix with electric whips and is arrested.
Freed by Justin Hammer, Vanko turns Hammer's drones on the Stark Expo and dies in his own blast.

k: A rival weapons maker
st: Hammer fakes Vanko's death and hires him to build drones for the Stark Expo.
The drones run wild at the Expo, and Hammer is arrested.
Hammer holds court in Seagate Prison and resents the fame of fellow inmate Trevor Slattery.

k: A senator demanding the Iron Man suit
st: Stern grills Tony at a Senate hearing and demands he hand over the suit.
Stern turns out to be HYDRA and is arrested after the helicarriers fall.

n: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
k: A Royal Marine hungry for more power
st: Blonsky takes a super soldier serum and Banner's blood, then tears up Harlem as a monster.
The Hulk beats Blonsky, who is taken into custody.
Blonsky, in Abomination form, fights Wong in a Macau cage match.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Blonsky wins parole with Jennifer Walters as his lawyer, saying he has changed.
Blonsky breaks the terms of his parole and is sent back to prison.
Wong opens a portal into Blonsky's cell and takes him away.

k: A US Army general hunting the Hulk
st: General Ross hunts Bruce Banner and pushes Blonsky into becoming a weapon.
Now Secretary of State, Ross pushes the Sokovia Accords and locks rogue Avengers in the Raft.
Ross hunts Natasha Romanoff for breaking the Accords.
Ross orders the arrest of Steve Rogers and his team when they return to the Avengers Compound.
Ross stands among the mourners at Tony Stark's funeral.
President Ross turns into the Red Hulk in Washington, then turns himself in and goes to the Raft.

k: A cell biologist helping Bruce Banner
st: Sterns studies Banner's blood, and a drop in a head wound starts to change him.
Sterns, now the Leader, mind-controls soldiers into attacks that push the US and Japan toward war.
Sam Wilson stops the Leader's plan, and Sterns ends up locked in the Raft.

k: Thor's brother, a prince of Asgard
st: Loki learns he is a Frost Giant, takes Asgard's throne, and falls into the void off the Bifrost.
Loki steals the Tesseract and leads a Chitauri invasion of New York, until the Avengers capture him.
Loki fights beside Thor against the Dark Elves, fakes his death, and takes Odin's throne in disguise.
Loki joins Thor to save Asgard's people from Hela.
Thanos kills Loki aboard the Asgardian refugee ship.
In 2012, the captured Loki grabs the Tesseract during the Avengers' time heist and escapes.
The TVA catches that Loki, and he slowly becomes an ally in the hunt for a dangerous variant.
Loki takes the throne at the end of time to hold the timelines together.

k: King of the Frost Giants of Jotunheim
st: Laufey's Frost Giants raid Odin's vault, and Thor's revenge attack breaks the old truce.
Laufey sneaks into Asgard to kill Odin at Loki's invitation, and Loki kills him.

k: Thanos's hooded envoy to the Chitauri
st: The Other gives Loki the Chitauri army and warns him not to fail.
The Other brings Thanos's warning to Ronan, and Ronan kills him.

k: A warlord who courts death
st: Thanos backs the Chitauri invasion of Earth from the shadows.
Thanos sends Ronan for the Orb, but Ronan keeps the stone inside for himself.
Thanos puts on an empty gauntlet and vows to get the stones himself.
Thanos gathers all six Infinity Stones and wipes out half of all life with a snap.
Thor kills Thanos in his garden, and a 2014 Thanos who follows the Avengers forward turns to dust.

k: A broke couple who find a Chitauri gun
st: Benny and Claire rob banks with a salvaged Chitauri gun.
Agent Sitwell catches them, and S.H.I.E.L.D. hires them instead of jailing them.

k: Ruler of the Dark Elves of Svartalfheim
st: Malekith wakes when Jane Foster absorbs the Aether, and attacks Asgard to take it.
Malekith tries to darken the universe at the Convergence in Greenwich, and his own ship crushes him.

k: Malekith's loyal lieutenant, Algrim
st: Algrim becomes the Kursed, breaks out of Asgard's prison, and kills Frigga in the raid.
Kurse runs Loki through on Svartalfheim, and Loki kills him with his own black hole grenade.

k: A Kree Accuser and fanatic
st: In 1995, Ronan's fleet comes to Earth to destroy the Skrulls' hideout, but Carol drives it off.
Ronan takes the Power Stone, betrays Thanos, and tries to destroy Xandar.
The Guardians share the stone's power and destroy Ronan.

k: A Kree hunter working for Ronan
st: In 1995, Korath serves with the Kree Starforce hunting Skrulls.
Korath hunts Peter Quill for the Orb and dies at Drax's hands.

k: Thanos's daughter and Ronan's lieutenant
st: Nebula serves Ronan, then flees after Gamora beats her.
Nebula hunts Gamora, makes peace with her, and leaves to kill Thanos.
Thanos captures and tortures Nebula, but she escapes to fight him on Titan.
Nebula joins the Avengers' time heist and kills her 2014 self, who works for Thanos.
Nebula fights beside Thor and the Guardians before the two teams part ways.
Nebula spends Christmas on Knowhere with the Guardians.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
Nebula fights beside the Guardians to save Rocket's life.

k: Ravager captain who raised Peter Quill
st: Kraglin recalls how Yondu ruined Christmas for a young Peter Quill aboard his ship.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
Yondu hunts Peter Quill for the Orb, but Peter hands him a fake.
Yondu helps save Peter from Ego and dies giving him his space suit.

k: A living planet who says he is Peter Quill's father
st: Ego reveals he planted seeds on countless worlds to remake the galaxy as himself.
Groot sets a bomb on Ego's core, and Ego dies.

k: High Priestess of the Sovereign
st: Ayesha hunts the Guardians after Rocket steals her batteries, and creates Adam.
Ayesha sends Adam Warlock after Rocket for the High Evolutionary.
Ayesha dies when the High Evolutionary bombs Counter-Earth.

k: A mutinous Ravager
st: Taserface leads a mutiny against Yondu and dies when the Ravager ship explodes.

k: Commander of the Kree Starforce
st: Yon-Rogg trains Vers as a Kree soldier and hides that he took her past. Carol beats Yon-Rogg on Earth and sends him back to Hala with a warning.

k: The AI that rules the Kree
st: The Supreme Intelligence holds Carol back with a Kree implant, until she breaks free.
Flashbacks show Carol destroying the Supreme Intelligence, and Hala falls into civil war.

k: A Kree Starforce sniper
st: Minn-Erva hunts Carol and the Skrulls, and Carol shoots down her ship.

k: A shape-shifting Skrull commander
st: Talos hunts Vers on Earth, posing as Nick Fury's boss.
Talos reveals the Skrulls are refugees, and Carol helps them escape.
Talos poses as Nick Fury to guide Peter Parker through the Elemental attacks in Europe.
Talos helps Fury hunt Gravik's Skrull rebels, and Gravik kills him.

k: Head of Advanced Idea Mechanics
st: Killian hides his Extremis soldiers' blasts behind a fake terrorist, the Mandarin.
Killian kidnaps the President and Pepper, and Pepper kills him.

k: The face of the Mandarin's broadcasts
st: Trevor, an actor, plays the Mandarin on TV for Killian, and is arrested once the hoax falls apart.
Ten Rings agents break Trevor out of Seagate, and he vanishes from the prison.
Trevor, kept by Wenwu as a jester, helps Shang-Chi reach Ta Lo, then goes off on his own.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Trevor spies on Simon Williams for Damage Control, and the two become close friends.
Trevor claims Simon's set explosion as the Mandarin and goes to a Damage Control prison.
Simon breaks Trevor out of the prison, and the two escape together.

k: A botanist who created Extremis
st: Maya works on Extremis for Killian, then turns on him to help Tony, and Killian shoots her dead.

k: Killian's Extremis enforcer
st: Savin attacks Air Force One to take the President, and Iron Man blasts him out of the plane.

k: An Extremis soldier
st: Brandt and Savin attack Tony in Tennessee, and Brandt dies in the fight.

k: The US Vice President
st: Rodriguez helps Killian's plot in return for a cure for his daughter, and is arrested.

k: A filmmaker interviewing Trevor Slattery
st: Norriss reveals he is a Ten Rings agent and takes Trevor to meet the real Mandarin.

k: A senior S.H.I.E.L.D. official
st: In 2012, Pierce argues with the Avengers over who keeps the Tesseract.
Pierce reveals himself as HYDRA and aims Project Insight's helicarriers at millions.
Nick Fury shoots Pierce dead as the helicarriers fall.

k: A ghost assassin with a metal arm
st: The Winter Soldier hunts Nick Fury and Captain America, and turns out to be Bucky Barnes.
Bucky pulls Steve out of the Potomac and vanishes.
Steve and Sam hold Bucky with his metal arm pinned in a vise.
Framed for the UN bombing, Bucky goes on the run, then chooses to be frozen in Wakanda.
Bucky wakes from cryosleep in Wakanda, and Shuri checks on him.
Bucky gets a new arm in Wakanda, fights Thanos's army, and turns to dust after the snap.
Bucky returns for the final battle against Thanos's army.
Bucky makes amends for the Winter Soldier's killings and fights the Flag Smashers beside Sam.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Now a congressman, Bucky joins the team that becomes the New Avengers.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. strike team leader
st: In 2012, Rumlow's team guards Loki's scepter and loses it to a time-traveling Captain America.
Rumlow reveals he is HYDRA and fights Cap, and a crashing helicarrier leaves him badly burned.
Rumlow, now Crossbones, raids Lagos and blows himself up, and the blast kills Wakandan aid workers.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent
st: In 2012, Sitwell hands Loki's scepter to a time-traveling Cap who whispers Hail HYDRA.
Sitwell gives up HYDRA's plan for Project Insight, then the Winter Soldier kills him.

k: A French mercenary and kickboxer
st: Batroc's pirates seize a S.H.I.E.L.D. ship, and he escapes after a fight with Captain America.
Batroc works with the Flag Smashers for money, and Sharon Carter kills him.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: A HYDRA leader studying Loki's scepter
st: Strucker experiments with Loki's scepter and holds two enhanced twins.
The Avengers raid Strucker's base in Sokovia and capture him.
Ultron kills Strucker in his cell.

k: Tony Stark's peacekeeping AI gone wrong
st: Ultron wakes in Stark's lab, builds himself a body, and decides humanity must go.
Ultron lifts Sokovia into the sky, and Vision destroys his last body.

k: A Sokovian test subject in Strucker's lab
st: Pietro is held in Strucker's HYDRA lab as a test subject.
Pietro joins Ultron, then turns on him and dies saving Clint in Sokovia.

k: A Sokovian test subject in Strucker's lab
cl: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
st: Wanda is held in Strucker's HYDRA lab as a test subject.
Wanda joins Ultron, then sees his real plan and fights beside the Avengers in Sokovia.
A blast Wanda tries to contain in Lagos kills aid workers, and she sides with Cap until Steve frees her from the Raft.
Wanda destroys the Mind Stone to keep it from Thanos, then turns to dust after his snap.
Wanda returns and fights the 2014 Thanos in the final battle.
Grieving Vision, Wanda traps Westview in a sitcom world, then lets it go and flies off with the Darkhold.
As the Scarlet Witch, Wanda hunts America Chavez across the multiverse to reach her sons.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
Wanda destroys the Darkhold in every universe and brings Mount Wundagore down on herself.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: An arms dealer who stole vibranium
st: Klaue sells vibranium to Ultron, who cuts off his arm.
Klaue robs a museum, escapes custody in Busan, and Killmonger kills him.

k: Hank Pym's former protege, now CEO of Pym Tech
st: Cross perfects the Yellowjacket shrinking suit to sell to HYDRA.
Ant-Man shrinks Cross's suit so far that it collapses in on him.
Cross, rebuilt by Kang as M.O.D.O.K., hunts Scott, then turns on Kang and dies.

k: A HYDRA agent and former S.H.I.E.L.D. official
st: Carson tries to buy Yellowjacket for HYDRA and slips away with a vial of the formula.

k: A Sokovian colonel seeking revenge on the Avengers
st: Zemo frames Bucky for the UN bombing and turns Iron Man against Captain America.
T'Challa stops Zemo from taking his own life and hands him over to the authorities.
Bucky breaks Zemo out of prison to help hunt the super soldier serum.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Zemo surrenders to the Dora Milaje, then has the captured Flag Smashers killed from the Raft.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: A HYDRA officer who ran the Winter Soldier
st: In 1991, Karpov sends the Winter Soldier to kill Howard and Maria Stark.
Zemo tortures Karpov for the Winter Soldier's code words and kills him.

k: Head of the Red Room
st: Dreykov runs the Red Room and controls an army of Widows with chemicals.
Natasha breaks his control, and Dreykov dies when the Red Room falls.

k: A masked fighter who copies any fighting style
st: Taskmaster hunts Natasha for Dreykov, and turns out to be his daughter Antonia.
Natasha frees Antonia from Dreykov's control.
Valentina sends Antonia into a vault trap with other assets, and Ghost shoots her dead.

k: A mystery woman who visits Yelena
st: Valentina tells Yelena at Natasha's grave that Clint Barton killed her sister.
Valentina recruits the disgraced John Walker as U.S. Agent.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Now CIA director, Valentina arrests her ex-husband Everett Ross.
Valentina tries to erase her secret projects, then calls the survivors the New Avengers to save herself.

k: An ex-US black ops soldier with ties to Wakanda
st: Erik, son of N'Jobu, kills Klaue and wins Wakanda's throne in ritual combat.
T'Challa beats Killmonger, who chooses death over prison.
Shuri meets Killmonger in the Ancestral Plane, and he urges her to take revenge.

k: Head of Wakanda's Border Tribe
st: W'Kabi backs Killmonger and leads the Border Tribe against T'Challa, then surrenders to Okoye.

k: A salvage boss selling alien-tech weapons
st: Adrian Toomes's crew steals alien tech after the Battle of New York and sells it as weapons.
Spider-Man saves Toomes from his own crash, and he goes to prison.
Pulled into another universe, Adrian Toomes is freed from a cell, builds a new suit and asks Morbius to team up.

k: Toomes's crew member with a shock gauntlet
st: Schultz takes over as the Shocker and is left webbed up for the police.

k: The first Shocker in Toomes's crew
st: Toomes fires Brice for drawing attention, then kills him by accident with an alien gun.

k: Toomes's weapons builder
st: Mason builds Toomes's alien-tech weapons, including the Vulture's wings.

k: A criminal buying Toomes's weapons
st: Gargan's ferry deal goes wrong, and Spider-Man leaves him for the FBI. In prison, Gargan presses Toomes to name Spider-Man.
Jean Grey frees Gargan from Damage Control and controls him as the Scorpion, until Spider-Man beats him.

k: A rogue master of the mystic arts
st: Kaecilius steals rites from Kamar-Taj and attacks the Sanctums to bring Dormammu to Earth.
Strange bargains with Dormammu, who drags Kaecilius into the Dark Dimension.

k: A zealot following Kaecilius
st: Lucian attacks Strange at the New York Sanctum, and Strange kills him.

k: Ruler of the Dark Dimension
st: Strange traps Dormammu in a time loop until he agrees to leave Earth alone.

k: A master of the mystic arts at Kamar-Taj
st: Mordo quits Kamar-Taj and starts stripping sorcerers of their power.
A variant of Mordo on Earth-838 captures Strange for the Illuminati.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: Odin's firstborn, the Goddess of Death
st: Hela breaks Mjolnir, seizes Asgard, and slaughters its army.
Thor unleashes Surtur, who destroys Asgard with Hela on it.

k: Asgard's new gatekeeper
st: Skurge serves as Hela's executioner, then dies defending Asgard's people.

k: A fire demon who foretells Ragnarok
st: Thor beats Surtur in Muspelheim and takes his crown. Loki revives Surtur in Asgard's vault, and Surtur destroys Asgard.

k: Ruler of Sakaar and its Contest of Champions
st: The Grandmaster forces Thor to fight the Hulk, and his people rise up and overthrow him.

k: A telekinetic member of Thanos's Black Order
st: Ebony Maw attacks New York for the Time Stone and takes Doctor Strange prisoner.
Iron Man and Spider-Man blow Maw out of his ship into space.
A 2014 Maw fights at the Avengers Compound and turns to dust.

k: A warrior of Thanos's Black Order
st: Proxima ambushes Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh, then leads the attack on Wakanda.
Wanda throws Proxima into the path of the army's threshers.
A 2014 Proxima fights at the Avengers Compound and turns to dust.

k: A warrior of Thanos's Black Order
st: Corvus attacks Vision in Edinburgh and again in Wakanda, where Vision kills him with his own glaive.
A 2014 Corvus fights at the Avengers Compound, where Okoye stabs him, and he turns to dust after Tony's snap.

k: The brute of Thanos's Black Order
st: Cull Obsidian fights in New York and Wakanda, and dies when Bruce drives him into the energy shield.
A 2014 Cull Obsidian fights at the Avengers Compound, and Giant-Man steps on him.

k: A masked thief who phases through walls
st: Ava Starr steals Hank Pym's lab, hoping its quantum energy will cure her pain.
Janet eases Ava's pain, and she leaves with Bill Foster.
Ava kills Taskmaster in Valentina's vault, then joins the team that becomes the New Avengers.

k: Hank Pym's former partner
st: Bill Foster helps Ghost hunt Hank Pym's lab to cure her, then leaves with her.

k: A black-market tech dealer
st: Burch tries to steal Hank Pym's lab to sell its quantum tech, and is arrested.

k: A judge of the Time Variance Authority
st: Judge Renslayer prunes Loki variants and hides that the TVA's own agents are variants.
Renslayer leaves the TVA to search for free will.
Renslayer joins Miss Minutes to hunt Victor Timely, then tries to seize the TVA.
A spellbound X-5 prunes Renslayer, and she wakes in the Void as Alioth closes in.

k: The TVA's cheerful cartoon clock
st: Miss Minutes guards He Who Remains' secrets and offers Loki and Sylvie a deal.
Miss Minutes helps Renslayer track Victor Timely to protect her creator's future.
Miss Minutes crushes Dox and her loyalists, then O.B.'s system reboot shuts her down.

k: The man behind the TVA, at the end of time
st: He Who Remains reveals he built the TVA to stop his variants' war, and Sylvie kills him.
Loki time-slips back to the Citadel, where He Who Remains explains the Loom before Sylvie kills him again.

k: A Loki variant hunting the TVA
st: Sylvie attacks TVA Minutemen and plants reset charges across the Sacred Timeline. Sylvie kills He Who Remains, and the timeline branches into a multiverse.
Sylvie starts a quiet life in 1982 Oklahoma, then joins Loki's friends at the TVA as the Loom fails.

k: A TVA Hunter
st: B-15 hunts and arrests Loki variants for the TVA.
Sylvie shows B-15 her old life, and she turns on the TVA.
B-15 works with Mobius and Loki to keep the TVA and its timelines alive.
B-15 arrives at the TVA and takes Paradox into custody.

k: A storm-like creature in the Void
st: Alioth devours whatever is pruned into the Void, until Sylvie enchants it.
Alioth closes in on Renslayer after she wakes in the Void.
Alioth still prowls the Void when Deadpool and Wolverine are dumped there.

k: A Loki variant who leads an army of Lokis
st: In the Void, President Loki ambushes Kid Loki's crew, until the Lokis all betray each other in a brawl.

k: A nosy Westview neighbor called Agnes
st: Nosy neighbor Agnes turns out to be Agatha, a witch who wants Wanda's power.
Wanda beats Agatha and traps her in Westview as Agnes.
Freed from Wanda's spell by a teen, Agatha gathers a coven to walk the Witches' Road.
Agatha gives her life to Death to protect Billy, and comes back as a ghost.

k: Acting director of S.W.O.R.D.
st: Hayward rebuilds Vision's body as a weapon and lies about it.
Monica Rambeau exposes Hayward, and he is arrested.

k: S.W.O.R.D.'s rebuilt Vision
st: White Vision fights Vision, gets his memories back, and flies away.

k: Leader of the Flag Smashers
st: Karli, a super soldier, leads the Flag Smashers in raids on the GRC.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Karli is shot by Sharon Carter during the GRC fight and dies.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: Super soldiers who want a world without borders
st: The Flag Smashers rob supply depots and bomb a GRC building, and Nico dies at John Walker's hands.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Arrested after the fight in New York, the Flag Smashers die when their transport explodes.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: The government's new Captain America
st: Walker takes the serum and kills a Flag Smasher in public with the shield.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Stripped of the shield and his rank, Walker becomes U.S. Agent for Valentina.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Walker joins the team that saves New York and becomes the New Avengers.

k: The unseen boss of Madripoor
st: The Power Broker rules Madripoor's underworld and wants the super soldier serum back.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
The Power Broker turns out to be Sharon Carter, who wins a pardon and her old job back.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: A hero who says he comes from another Earth
st: Quentin Beck fakes Elemental attacks with drones and illusions to take Iron Man's place.
Beck dies fighting Spider-Man in London, leaving a fake video that names Peter as Spider-Man.

k: Beck's drone operator
st: Riva runs Beck's drones and gets away with the footage from London.

k: A Department of Damage Control agent
st: Cleary questions Peter and his friends over Mysterio's death, until the charges are dropped.
Cleary sends Deever after Kamala, then relieves her of duty when she defies his order to stand down.
Cleary's Damage Control has Trevor Slattery spy on Simon Williams, an actor with hidden powers.

k: Leader of the Tracksuit Mafia
st: Maya hunts the Ronin who killed her father, which leads her to Clint Barton. Maya learns her uncle ordered her father's death, and confronts him.
Back in Oklahoma, Maya defies Fisk, reconnects with her family, and breaks his hold on her.

k: Maya's friend and second in command
st: Kazi sides with the Kingpin against Maya, and she kills him on Christmas Eve.

k: Kate Bishop's mother, a security CEO
st: Eleanor runs Bishop Security while secretly working with the Kingpin.
Eleanor admits to killing Armand Duquesne III, and the police arrest her on Christmas Eve.

k: A New York gang that calls everyone bro
st: The Tracksuit Mafia hunts Clint and Kate across New York. Clint and Kate beat the gang in the Christmas Eve battle at Rockefeller Center.

k: A Widow raised as Natasha's sister
st: Under Red Room mind control, Yelena kills a rogue Widow, until a red gas frees her.
At Natasha's grave, Valentina tells Yelena that Clint Barton killed her sister.
Yelena hunts Clint, believing he killed Natasha.
Yelena learns the truth about Natasha's death and lets Clint go.
Yelena takes Valentina's dirty jobs, then helps save New York with the team called the New Avengers.

k: A giant one-eyed monster
st: Gargantos chases America Chavez through New York, and Strange and Wong kill it.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: A Strange variant corrupted by the Darkhold
st: Sinister Strange caused the incursion that destroyed his universe, and Strange kills him to take his Darkhold.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: Earth-838's council of heroes
st: The Illuminati put Strange on trial for the danger he poses.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
The Scarlet Witch kills most of the Illuminati in their own headquarters.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

k: A Deviant who steals Eternal powers
st: Kro grows stronger by draining Eternal powers, and kills Gilgamesh.

k: An Eternal who can fly and fire laser beams
st: Ikaris led Ajak to her death and turns on the team to protect Tiamut's Emergence.
Ikaris cannot bring himself to kill Sersi and flies into the sun.

k: An Eternal who looks like a child forever
st: Sprite sides with Ikaris to let the Emergence happen.
Sersi turns Sprite human, as she has long wished.

k: The Celestial who made the Eternals
st: Arishem planted the Celestial Tiamut inside Earth to be born. Arishem takes Sersi, Kingo and Phastos to judge whether humanity should live.

k: Master of the Ten Rings
st: Wenwu hunts his children for their mother's pendants.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Wenwu attacks Ta Lo to free the wife he hears behind its gate, and the Dweller-in-Darkness kills him.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: A Ten Rings enforcer with a blade for an arm
st: Razor Fist hunts Shang-Chi in San Francisco and Macau.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Razor Fist fights the soul eaters beside Ta Lo's defenders.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: A masked Ten Rings assassin
st: Death Dealer trained a young Shang-Chi to kill, and a soul eater kills him at Ta Lo.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: A soul-eating monster sealed behind Ta Lo
st: The Dweller tricks Wenwu into opening its gate.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Shang-Chi and the Great Protector kill the Dweller.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: A cult leader who once served Khonshu
st: Harrow hunts for Ammit's tomb so she can judge people before they sin.
Moon Knight and Layla seal Ammit inside Harrow, and Jake Lockley kills him.

k: An Egyptian goddess who judges souls
st: Harrow frees Ammit, who starts judging the people of Cairo.
Khonshu and Taweret's avatars seal Ammit inside Harrow's body.

k: A wealthy collector of antiquities
st: Mogart turns on Marc and Layla over a sarcophagus, and his fate is unclear after Marc blacks out.

k: Widow of the monster hunter Ulysses
st: Verussa holds a hunt for the Bloodstone with a monster named Ted as the prey.
Verussa tries to shoot Elsa, and Ted burns her to death.

k: A grieving man with a god-killing sword
st: Gorr takes the Necrosword and murders gods across the universe.
Gorr reaches Eternity and wishes his daughter back to life, then dies.

k: King of the Greek gods in Omnipotence City
st: Zeus refuses to help against Gorr and tries to keep Thor and his friends prisoner. Thor runs Zeus through with his own Thunderbolt, but he lives and sends Hercules after Thor.

k: The scientist who made Rocket
st: The High Evolutionary wants Rocket's brain back and wipes out his own Counter-Earth.
Rocket spares the beaten High Evolutionary, and the Guardians free the children and animals he caged.

k: A golden warrior made by the Sovereign
st: Adam Warlock attacks Knowhere to grab Rocket.
Adam saves Peter Quill in space and joins the new Guardians.

k: Head of security on the Orgoscope
st: Karja leads the Orgoscope's guards and fires on the Guardians when he sees through their disguises.

k: Leader of the ClanDestine
st: Najma and the ClanDestine push Kamala to open the Veil to their home dimension.
Najma stays behind to close the Veil and dies, asking Kamala to look after Kamran.

k: A Department of Damage Control agent
st: Deever leads Damage Control's hunt for Kamala and Kamran across Jersey City.

k: A rich tech bro who dates Jen
st: Todd, the troll HulkKing, has Intelligencia leak a video of Jen at an awards gala.
Todd injects himself with Jen's blood and is arrested after the fight.

k: An influencer with super strength
st: Titania smashes into Jen's courtroom, and She-Hulk knocks her out.
Titania sues to claim the She-Hulk name, and loses in court.
Titania turns up at the Intelligencia summit to fight Jen, and she is arrested.

k: Thugs with stolen Asgardian tools
st: The Wrecking Crew jumps Jen to take her blood, and she beats them. The Wrecker turns up at Emil's retreat, scuffles with Jen, then apologizes for attacking her.

k: A rich man in a frog-themed super suit
st: Leap-Frog kidnaps the designer of his faulty suit, until She-Hulk and Daredevil stop him and he is arrested.

k: A rogue Wakandan ruling ancient Crete
st: The Lion rules Crete like a god and raids for slaves with stolen Wakandan tech.
Noni beats the Lion in a duel, and he dies setting off a blast that destroys his stronghold.

k: King of the undersea nation of Talokan
st: Namor demands Wakanda find the scientist who built a vibranium detector. Namor floods Wakanda's capital, and Queen Ramonda dies.
Shuri beats Namor and spares him, and they make a truce.

k: A Talokan warrior general
st: Attuma leads Talokan raids on the US and on Wakanda.

k: One of Namor's fiercest warriors
st: Namora fights Wakanda's forces at Namor's command.

k: A crime boss in a magic cloak
st: Parker Robbins wears a cloak of dark power and leads a heist crew in Chicago. Riri tears the hood off Parker, and he goes to Zelma Stanton looking for magical help.

k: A devil who makes deals
st: Mephisto turns out to be the source of Parker's hood, and Riri takes his deal to bring back Natalie.

k: Leader of a Skrull rebellion
st: Gravik plants Skrull impostors to push humans toward war, and kills Talos.
Gravik becomes a Super Skrull with Avengers DNA, and G'iah kills him.

k: Gravik's second in command
st: Pagon carries out Gravik's orders, until Gravik kills him.

k: A Skrull posing as James Rhodes
st: Raava, posing as Rhodes, pushes President Ritson toward war.
Fury and Sonya Falsworth trap the impostor, and Fury shoots Raava dead.

k: Leader of the Kree
st: Dar-Benn uses a quantum band to tear open jump points and steal other worlds' resources.
Dar-Benn overloads herself with the band's power and is destroyed.

k: A Green Witch and Agatha's old flame
st: Rio hunts Agatha along the Witches' Road. Rio turns out to be Death herself, and claims Agatha's life.

k: Spectral riders hunting Agatha
st: The Salem Seven ride after Agatha's coven as it starts down the Witches' Road.
Lilia turns a room upside down, and falling swords kill the Salem Seven.

k: Leader of the Serpent Society
st: Sidewinder's Serpent Society deals in stolen secrets and clashes with Sam Wilson.
Captured, Sidewinder names Samuel Sterns as the buyer in exchange for a lighter sentence.

k: A survivor of a secret super soldier trial
st: Bob becomes the Sentry, then the Void, swallowing New York in shadow.
The team reaches Bob inside his darkness, and he joins them as the New Avengers.

k: An exile trapped in the Quantum Realm
st: Kang rules part of the Quantum Realm and needs Janet's help to escape his exile.
Scott and Hope drive Kang into his own power core.

k: Countless variants of Kang
st: A vast council of Kang variants gathers to plan its next move.

k: A Quantum Realm noble who knew Janet
st: Lord Krylar welcomes Janet back, then tips off Kang's forces.

k: A 1901 inventor in Chicago
st: In 1901 Chicago, Victor Timely shows off his inventions as Loki and Mobius watch.
Victor tries to fix the Loom for the TVA, and its radiation tears him apart.

k: A TVA general
st: Dox prunes branched timelines with bombs until the TVA locks her up.
Dox refuses to join Renslayer, and Miss Minutes crushes her and her loyalists.

k: A TVA Hunter turned movie star
st: X-5 deserts the TVA to become movie star Brad Wolfe, until Loki and Mobius bring him in.
X-5 joins Renslayer's grab for the TVA, but Sylvie's spell makes him prune Renslayer.
After Loki saves the timelines, Brad Wolfe lives a new life on a branch timeline as a movie star.

k: Charles Xavier's twin sister, ruler of the Void
st: Cassandra rules the Void and plans to use Paradox's Time Ripper to end whole universes.
Cassandra dies in the Time Ripper's power surge.

k: A TVA agent with a Time Ripper
st: Paradox plans to erase Deadpool's universe with a Time Ripper.
B-15 arrives and takes Paradox into TVA custody.

k: A mysterious telepath
st: Jean Grey controls the Scorpion and the Hulk to strike at Damage Control over her sister Sara.
Spider-Man gets an inhibitor chip on Jean, and Metzger sedates her and locks her up.
When Peter takes a bullet meant for Jean, she keeps him alive with her mind and leaves on a bus.

k: Head of the Department of Damage Control
st: Metzger's Damage Control held telepath Sara Grey for experiments that killed her, and now holds Jean.
Metzger slips away in the chaos on Roosevelt Island.

k: A giant who devours worlds
st: Galactus comes to devour Earth and demands Sue's unborn son Franklin in exchange.
The Fantastic Four and the Silver Surfer force Galactus through a portal far from Earth.

k: Galactus's herald, Shalla-Bal
st: The Silver Surfer comes to Earth to announce Galactus is coming.
Johnny reaches Shalla-Bal, and she turns on Galactus to save Earth.
Shalla-Bal pushes Johnny aside and drives Galactus through the portal, vanishing with him.

k: Ruler of the world beneath the city
st: In the team's first showdown, Mole Man sinks the Pan Am Building and sets the monster Giganto loose.
Mole Man, an old foe of the team, lets the city shelter in his tunnels from Galactus.

k: A tech genius who befriends Riri
st: Joe turns out to be Ezekiel Stane, Obadiah's son, and ends up in prison after turning on Riri.
Parker breaks Ezekiel out and controls his implants, until Riri frees him and he warns her they are not done.

k: A reclusive businessman remaking Hell's Kitchen
st: Fisk unites the city's crime lords to remake Hell's Kitchen, until Daredevil and a witness put him in prison.
From his cell, Fisk takes control of the prison and uses Frank Castle to kill a rival inmate.
Fisk trades FBI help for his release and frames Daredevil, until Matt beats him and sends him back to prison.
As the Kingpin, Fisk runs the Tracksuit Mafia, until Kate beats him and Maya turns a gun on him.
Fisk survives Maya's shot and comes for her in Oklahoma, but she breaks his hold and he turns to politics.
Fisk is elected mayor of New York and seizes the city with his Anti-Vigilante Task Force.
Exposed at Karen's trial, Fisk resigns as mayor and takes a deal to leave New York without prosecution.

k: An art gallery owner who wins Fisk's heart
st: Vanessa learns what Fisk really is, chooses him anyway, and leaves the country as he falls.
Vanessa returns to marry Fisk and orders the murder of FBI Agent Ray Nadeem.
Vanessa runs Fisk's empire while he is away, and Matt learns she hired Bullseye to kill Foggy Nelson.
At Fisk's charity boxing match, a glass shard from Bullseye's attack strikes Vanessa's head, and she dies in hospital.

k: Fisk's loyal right-hand man
st: In the past, Wesley recruits Buck Cashman into Fisk's operation.
Wesley handles Fisk's deals and threats, keeping his boss's name out of sight.
Wesley abducts Karen Page to silence her, and she kills him with his own gun.

k: Fisk's accountant and money man
st: Owlsley manages the money behind Fisk's alliance and grows tired of his boss.
Owlsley plots against Fisk, who throws him down an elevator shaft.

k: A heroin queen with a mysterious past
st: Gao runs heroin through Fisk's alliance, then walks away as his empire falls.
Gao, still running heroin out of Chinatown, meets Daredevil face to face again.
Gao is revealed as a leader of the Hand moving heroin through Rand Enterprises, and Danny captures her.
Bakuto's people lock Gao in a cell at their compound, but she escapes.
As one of the Hand's Fingers, Gao is caught in the Midland Circle collapse.

k: A Japanese crime boss in Fisk's alliance
st: Nobu fights Daredevil for Fisk and dies engulfed in flames.
Nobu is back, alive, leading the Hand in Hell's Kitchen, and kills Elektra.
Matt throws Nobu off a rooftop, and when Nobu gets back up, Stick cuts off his head.

k: A Russian mobster in Fisk's alliance
st: Anatoly interrupts Fisk's date with Vanessa, and Fisk kills him with a car door.

k: A Russian mobster in Fisk's alliance
st: Vladimir blames Daredevil for his brother's death, then learns Fisk was the killer.
Trapped by Fisk's corrupt police, Vladimir stays behind to hold them off and dies.

k: A detective on Fisk's payroll
st: Blake takes Fisk's money and ends up in hospital, where his partner Hoffman kills him.

k: A detective on Fisk's payroll
st: Hoffman kills his partner Blake on Fisk's orders, then flees for his life.
Hoffman turns himself in and testifies against Fisk.

k: A hitman working for Fisk
st: Healy kills a rival for Fisk, names his boss under Daredevil's fists, and then kills himself.

k: A small-time crook in Hell's Kitchen
st: Turk runs a human trafficking deal at the docks until Daredevil breaks it up.
Turk keeps selling guns in Hell's Kitchen and keeps running into Daredevil.
In Harlem, Turk tips off Tone to where Chico is hiding, which leads to the shooting at Pop's barbershop. Diamondback hires Turk to sell his weapons on the street.
Turk is still hustling in Harlem as Luke hunts Bushmaster.

k: Fisk's fixer
st: Manning runs Fisk's plans outside prison and threatens Karen Page.
Daredevil dangles Manning off a roof until he agrees to testify, and Detective Mahoney arrests him.

k: An FBI chief in charge of Fisk's case
st: Hattley secretly works for Fisk inside the FBI, until the police raid on his hotel ends in her arrest.

k: An FBI agent with deadly aim and a broken mind
st: Fisk turns Agent Dex Poindexter into a killer who attacks the Bulletin in Daredevil's suit.
Dex turns on Fisk, who breaks his back, and after the police raid surgeons rebuild his spine.
Bullseye kills Foggy Nelson at Josie's, and Daredevil's fight with him ends in his arrest.
Bullseye escapes prison and shoots at Mayor Fisk, but Matt takes the bullet.

Bullseye saves Matt from the Task Force, then attacks Fisk's charity boxing match, fatally wounding Vanessa. Bullseye fires at Fisk outside the courthouse and hits Buck, then flies off with Mr. Charles as his new operative.

k: Matt's old flame and a trained assassin
st: Elektra pulls Matt into her war with the Hand and dies taking Nobu's blade.
Revived by the Hand as the Black Sky, Elektra kills Alexandra and Stick and takes the Hand for herself.
Elektra stays with Matt as Midland Circle collapses on them both.

k: An ancient order of ninja
st: The Hand drains children's blood and digs a giant pit beneath Hell's Kitchen.
The Hand works inside Rand Enterprises and runs a dojo network through Bakuto.
The Defenders blow up Midland Circle, burying the Hand's leaders under the rubble.
Beaten by Spider-Man, the Hand's remnants become Damage Control's security, until Jean Grey turns them against him.

k: Frank's former commanding officer
st: Colonel Schoonover, Frank's old commander, is the Blacksmith behind the shootout that killed Frank's family.
Frank hunts Schoonover down and kills him.

k: Boss of the Kitchen Irish
st: Finn Cooley captures Frank and tortures him, and Frank breaks free and kills him.

k: A small-time Kitchen Irish gangster
st: Grotto seeks Daredevil's protection, and Frank shoots him dead in front of Matt.

k: New York's District Attorney
st: Reyes hides her part in the botched sting that killed Frank's family, and is later shot dead.

k: A man whose words force people to obey
st: Kilgrave comes back for Jessica, forcing Hope Shlottman to kill her own parents.
Jessica lets Kilgrave think he controls her, then snaps his neck at the docks.
Kilgrave appears only in Jessica's mind, a memory she has to face.
Kilgrave surfaces once more in Jessica's mind, taunting her as she thinks about leaving New York.

k: An NYPD sergeant drawn into Jessica's war
st: Simpson takes combat pills from a secret program and hunts Jessica and Trish until Jessica knocks him out.
Simpson resurfaces with warnings about IGH and is killed soon after.

k: A super-strong killer tied to IGH
st: Alisa, Jessica's mother, kills people tied to IGH in fits of uncontrolled rage.
Alisa escapes prison and goes on the run with Jessica, until Trish shoots her dead.

k: The IGH doctor who gave Jessica her powers
st: Malus experiments on Trish to give her powers, then dies when his clinic blows up.

k: Jessica's best friend, a radio host
st: Trish takes Malus's procedure for powers and shoots Alisa dead.
With new powers and a mask, Trish kills criminals she has judged guilty.
Jessica stops Trish, who is sent to the Raft.

k: A genius serial killer who hates heroes
st: Sallinger hunts powered people he sees as cheats and kills Trish's mother Dorothy.
Jessica tricks Sallinger into confessing, and Trish kills him in police custody.

k: Harlem's nightclub-owning crime boss
st: Cornell Stokes runs guns out of Harlem's Paradise and starts a war with Luke Cage.
In a rage, his cousin Mariah beats Cornell to death.

k: A Harlem councilwoman with a crime family
st: Mariah kills her cousin Cottonmouth in a rage and pins the murder on Luke.
Mariah takes over Cornell's empire with Shades at her side and walks free.
As Black Mariah, she wars with Bushmaster and orders an attack on the Jamaican Stylers.
Jailed at last, Mariah is poisoned by her daughter Tilda and dies, leaving Harlem's Paradise to Luke.

k: A smooth enforcer with a long prison record
st: Shades, sent by Diamondback, steers Mariah toward taking Cornell's empire.
Shades kills his friend Comanche, then turns himself in and testifies against Mariah.

k: An arms dealer with a grudge against Luke
st: Willis Stryker, Luke's half-brother, hunts him with Judas bullets that can pierce his skin.
In a powered suit, Stryker loses to Luke in the street and is arrested.

k: A detective on Cottonmouth's payroll
st: Scarfe, Misty's corrupt partner, turns on Cottonmouth and is shot by him, later dying of the wound.

k: A nightshade-powered avenger from Jamaica
st: Bushmaster beats Luke and goes after Mariah's family to take back what Harlem stole from his. Badly hurt, Bushmaster leaves New York for Jamaica.

k: A holistic doctor and Mariah's daughter
st: Tilda turns on her mother and poisons Mariah in prison.

k: Danny's father's partner, secretly alive
st: Harold, kept alive by the Hand, runs his children's lives from hiding.
Harold breaks from the Hand and turns on Danny, and his son Ward shoots him dead.

k: Colleen's sensei
st: Bakuto leads a faction of the Hand that wants Danny, until he is cut down and left for dead.
Bakuto returns alive, cuts off Misty Knight's arm, and is beheaded by Colleen.

k: Danny's brother in arms from K'un-Lun
st: Davos arrives from K'un-Lun, furious that Danny left his post.
With Joy's help, Davos steals the Iron Fist and attacks Chinatown's gangs.
Danny and Colleen defeat Davos, Colleen takes the Iron Fist, and the police take him away.

k: Ward's sister and a Rand executive
st: Joy helps Davos steal the Iron Fist, then breaks with him when his crusade turns deadly.

k: A former soldier with a second personality
st: Mary Walker is hired to watch Danny's allies, and her violent other self takes over.

k: The Hand's ancient, dying leader
st: Alexandra raises Elektra as the Black Sky to reach the treasure under Midland Circle.
Elektra turns on Alexandra and kills her.

k: A Finger of the Hand
st: Murakami fights the Defenders as the Hand digs under Midland Circle.
Murakami is caught in the Midland Circle collapse.

k: A Finger of the Hand
st: Captured by the Defenders, Sowande is killed by Stick, who sends his head to the Hand.

k: Frank's Marine friend, now a private army boss
st: Billy is revealed as Rawlins' partner, who knew about the hit on Frank's family.
Frank smashes Billy's face into a mirror at the carousel, leaving him scarred and under arrest.
Billy escapes the hospital with gaps in his memory and builds a crew of veterans.

k: A CIA officer with a past in Kandahar
st: Rawlins ran heroin through a covert unit and ordered the hit that killed Frank's family.
Frank kills Rawlins in a brutal fight at the carousel.

k: A young veteran unable to come home
st: Lewis starts a bombing campaign in New York and dies in his own blast.

k: A reformed zealot sent after a runaway girl
st: Pilgrim hunts Frank and Amy for the Schultzes, who hold his sons' safety over him.
Frank spares Pilgrim and sends him home to his sons.

k: A rich, devout couple guarding a secret
st: Anderson and Eliza Schultz send Pilgrim to silence Amy and protect their senator son.
Frank confronts the Schultzes at their home, and both of them die.

k: Billy Russo's therapist
st: Krista falls for her patient Billy and hides him from the law, until Madani throws her out a window. Krista survives the fall, badly hurt.

k: Matriarch of the Gnucci crime family
st: Ma Gnucci puts a bounty on Frank Castle and sends Little Sicily's criminals after him. Frank stops to protect bystanders instead of chasing her, and Ma Gnucci escapes.

k: A serial killer who paints with blood
st: Muse kills and drains his victims to paint murals across the city.
Muse is shot dead by his therapist, Heather Glenn.

k: Fisk's masked police unit
st: Mayor Fisk forms a task force of dirty cops to hunt vigilantes and seize the city.
The Task Force hunts Daredevil and locks down the courthouse during Karen's trial.

k: A dirty cop who copies the Punisher
st: Sergeant North, hiding behind a skull mask, guns down Hector Ayala.
North is caught in a grenade blast when the Task Force raids Matt's apartment.
North survives with burn scars, rejoins the Task Force, and refuses Powell's order to fire on protesters.

k: A dirty cop loyal to Fisk
st: Powell leads the dirty cops who become Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force.
Powell orders his officers to fire on protesters at the courthouse, and North strikes him.

k: Fisk's fixer and enforcer
st: In the past, James Wesley recruits Buck into Fisk's operation.
Buck handles Fisk's dirty work as the new mayor takes power.
Buck shoots Daniel Blake dead for protecting BB Urich.
Buck takes a bullet Bullseye meant for Fisk outside the courthouse, and his fate is left unclear.

k: A smooth operative with ties to Langley
st: Mr. Charles loses a weapons shipment to Fisk's Task Force and offers to help the governor push Fisk out. Mr. Charles leaves New York on a plane, taking Bullseye on as his new operative.

k: Parker Robbins's heist crew in Chicago
st: Slug, John, Clown and the Blood siblings pull heists for Parker, with Riri along as their new recruit. John dies in the Heirlum heist, and Parker tells the crew that Riri is to blame. As the hood consumes Parker, he drives his crew away, and they leave him to face Riri alone.

k: Baron Strucker's HYDRA scientist
st: In a hidden HYDRA lab, List stands with Strucker over Loki's scepter and their enhanced test subjects.
When the Avengers raid the Sokovia base, List tries to wipe HYDRA's files, and Iron Man kills him.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. STRIKE agent serving HYDRA
st: In 2012, Rollins rides an elevator with Steve and the STRIKE team, and Steve talks his way out with the scepter.
Rollins and Rumlow's STRIKE team jump Steve in a Triskelion elevator, and Steve fights his way out.

k: An eccentric hoarder of rare cosmic relics
st: Sif and Volstagg leave the Aether with the Collector, who means to gather the other stones.
The Collector buys the Orb, and its stone blasts his museum apart when his servant Carina grabs it.
On Knowhere, Thanos, already holding the Reality Stone, traps Gamora with an illusion of the Collector's museum.

k: Kree soldiers of Starforce
st: Att-Lass and Bron-Char fight Skrulls with Starforce, then hunt Carol on Earth, where her full power overwhelms them.

k: A tentacled beast that feeds on batteries
st: Hired by the Sovereign, the Guardians fight the Abilisk, and Gamora cuts it open through a wound in its neck.

k: A Russian arms dealer
st: Luchkov has Natasha tied to a chair for questioning, and she breaks free and beats him and his men.

k: Leader of Wakanda's Jabari Tribe
st: M'Baku challenges T'Challa for the throne at Warrior Falls, and yields when T'Challa spares him.
M'Baku shelters the wounded T'Challa and leads the Jabari into battle against Killmonger.

k: A Wakandan prince undercover in Oakland
st: In 1992, N'Jobu helps Klaue steal vibranium, and King T'Chaka kills him when he draws a gun on Zuri.

k: Killmonger's partner in Klaue's crew
st: Linda helps Killmonger and Klaue rob a London museum, and Killmonger shoots her when Klaue uses her as a shield.

k: A small-time criminal shopping for weapons
st: Davis tries to buy alien-tech weapons, and Spider-Man webs him to his car to learn where the next deal is.

k: Hela's giant wolf
st: Hela raises Fenris from the dead, and the Hulk wrestles it off the Rainbow Bridge into the sea.

k: The Grandmaster's bodyguard
st: Topaz enforces the Grandmaster's rule on Sakaar and leads the hunt for Thor and Valkyrie.

k: A Red Room scientist and former spy
st: Melina, now working for Dreykov, signals the Red Room when Natasha, Yelena and Alexei reach her farm.
Inside the Red Room, Melina turns on Dreykov and helps the sisters bring it down.

k: Dreykov's mind-controlled assassins
st: Under Dreykov's chemical control, the Widows hunt Natasha and Yelena for the Red Room.
Natasha releases the antidote and frees the Widows, and they leave with Yelena to free others.

k: A yakuza boss in Tokyo
st: Ronin tears through Akihiko's crew in rainy Tokyo and kills him with a sword.

k: One of Sonny Burch's henchmen
st: Uzman helps Burch go after Hank's lab, and police arrest him along with Burch.

k: Wilson Fisk's abusive father
st: In flashbacks, Bill Fisk beats his wife, and young Wilson kills him with a hammer.

k: A trigger-happy thug in Cottonmouth's crew
st: Tone shoots up Pop's barbershop chasing Chico, and Cottonmouth throws him off a roof for it.

k: A Dominican gang boss in Harlem
st: Domingo deals guns in Harlem and clashes with Cottonmouth's crew.
Domingo and his men end up dead at Diamondback's hideout, where Luke finds their bodies.

k: Shades's old friend from Seagate prison
st: Comanche joins Mariah's crew while secretly informing for the police, and Shades kills him.

k: The Hand's drunken-fist defender
st: Zhou Cheng guards the Hand's heroin operation in China, and Danny beats him until Claire makes him stop.

k: Madame Gao's chosen fighters
st: In Gao's duel, Danny beats her fighters one by one: the Veznikov brothers, the Bride of Nine Spiders and Scythe.

k: Harold Meachum's son, running Rand Enterprises
st: Ward has Danny locked in a psychiatric ward to keep him away from Rand Enterprises.
Ward turns on his father and the Hand, and shoots Harold dead to save Danny.

k: A corrupt Homeland Security agent
st: Wolf, tied to Rawlins's heroin smuggling, is killed by Frank in his own home.

k: A lifer inmate in Fisk's pay
st: On Fisk's orders, inmate Jasper Evans stabs him, which gets Fisk moved out of prison.
Evans is brought to the Bulletin to testify, and Dex kills him there before he can.

k: A crime boss in Madripoor
st: Selby deals with Sam, Bucky and Zemo over the serum, until an unseen gunman shoots her dead.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: A former HYDRA scientist hiding in Madripoor
st: Nagel rebuilt the super soldier serum for the Power Broker, and Zemo shoots him dead.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: Rival hunters gathered at Bloodstone Manor
st: Hunters including Jovan, Azarel, Barasso and Liorn compete in Verussa's hunt for the Bloodstone.
None of the hunters survives the bloody night at Bloodstone Manor.

k: Zeus's son, a god of Olympus
st: Zeus, alive after Thor's attack, sends his son Hercules to make Thor pay.

k: A bull-headed brawler in Emil Blonsky's retreat
st: Man-Bull brawls with El Aguila and wrecks Jen's car, then sits in on Emil's group therapy.

k: A quilled crook in Emil Blonsky's retreat
st: Porcupine keeps his mask on through most of Emil's group therapy at the retreat.

k: A man in Emil Blonsky's retreat who says he is a vampire
st: Saracen joins Emil's group therapy and tells Jen that Josh just wanted her blood.

k: A New York crime boss
st: Crime boss Tombstone takes on Spider-Man in a montage of Peter's years alone, and ends up webbed up for the police.

k: A crook with trick boomerangs
st: Boomerang tangles with Spider-Man in a montage of Peter's years fighting crime alone.

k: A battering-ram brute
st: Ramrod charges Spider-Man and smashes into a wall in front of scared onlookers.

k: A spike-booted fighter
st: Tarantula fights Spider-Man aboard a ship in New York Harbor during a montage of Peter's fights.

k: A cosmic-powered orangutan of the Red Ghost's
st: In the team's early years, Reed slingshots himself into the Super-Ape and knocks it into the bay.

k: A cloaked stranger who visits young Franklin
st: Years later, a cloaked figure kneels beside young Franklin, holding a metal mask, while Sue fetches a book.

k: A Ten Rings commander in Afghanistan
st: Abu Bakaar leads the Ten Rings' attack on Gulmira, and Iron Man leaves him to the mercy of the villagers.

k: One of Sonny Burch's henchmen
st: Anitolov helps Burch hunt Hank's lab, until Burch's crew is dosed with its own truth serum and arrested.

k: One of Sonny Burch's henchmen
st: Knox helps Burch hunt Hank's lab, until Burch's crew is dosed with its own truth serum and arrested.

k: Warlord of the Booskan raiders
st: Habooska leads the Booskan raid on Indigarr, and dies when Thor joins the Guardians and crushes his army.

k: One of the High Evolutionary's Recorders
st: Theel carries the passkey to Rocket's kill switch, and dies in the fall when Quill and Groot leap with him to Counter-Earth.

k: A member of the council that oversees S.H.I.E.L.D.
The Avengers
A powerful businessman and HYDRA leader
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
st: This councilman and the rest of the World Security Council go over Fury's head and fire a nuclear missile at Manhattan.
In season 3, Malick brings Hive back to Earth to lead HYDRA.
Under Hive's influence, Daisy kills Malick.

k: Cottonmouth's muscle in Harlem
st: Zip provides muscle for Cottonmouth, and after his death Diamondback makes Zip one of his advisers.
Sent by Diamondback to kill Shades, Zip loses the fight, and Shades shoots him dead.

k: An Italian crime boss eyeing Harlem
st: With Mariah jailed and Harlem's gangs at war, Luke warns Rosalie Carbone to keep her mob out of Harlem.
